grammar.title: 煽动翅膀飞行的鸟类
lines: 6 The albatross is the king of the gliders , the class of fliers which harness the air to their purpose , but must yield to its opposition . be the king / queen of sth. …中最好的/佼佼者 yield to 屈服于/服从于 One January, I had to officiate at two funerals on successive days for two elderly women in my community. Both had died “full of years,” as the Bible would say; both yielded to the normal wearing out of the body after a long and full life. 阅读真题 In the contrary school , the duck is supreme. school n.流派/学派 the duck is supreme . ⇒ The duck is the king of the contrary school. It comes nearer to the engines with which man has ' conquered ' the air, as he boasts . come nearer to 更像/更接近 It is similar to the engines with which man has 'conquered' the air, as he boasts. 替换表达 man → he / mankind / the human race → it 代词指代 boast of / about 吹牛/夸耀 If, as has been reported , they have protected humans from sharks, it may have been because curiosity attracted them and because the scent of a possible meal attracted the sharks. 关系代词在定语从句里做主语 Things can go wrong on a big scale, as a number of people recently discovered in Parramatta, a suburb of Sydney. Duck , and like them the pigeons , are endowed with steel-like muscles , that are a good part of the weight of the bird , and these will ply the short wings with such irresistible power t hat they can bore for long distances through an opposing gale before exhaustion follows . -like 像…的（复合形容词） Foxes and farmers have never got on well. These small dog-like animals have long been accused of killing farm animals. (CET-4) a good part of... 很大一部分…/很多 ply sb. with sth. 给某人源源不断地提供… bore for long distances 穿行很长距离（夸张） 夸张修辞 (hyperbole) 增强表达效果 白发三千丈 , 缘愁似个长; 危楼高百尺 , 手可摘星辰; 燕山雪花大如席 , 片片吹落轩辕台 中文夸张修辞 For she was beautiful — her beauty made the bright world dim, and everything beside seemed like the fleeting image of a shade. —— P. B. Shelley ‘The Witch of Atlas’ opposing / adverse / unfavorable gale / wind 逆风 before 才（ 强调主句时间长 ）;然后；直到；就(强调主句的时间很短时) Marxist convictions plied the Red Army with such irresistible power that they trekked for 25,000 li over snow-capped mountains and grassy swamps before they reached the town of Wuqi, destination of the Long March. 马克思主义的信念源源不断地给与红军巨大的动力，他们翻雪山、过草地，跋涉两万五干里，直到到达了长征的终点—吴起镇。
He is the new king of pop music. 他是流行音乐的新一代王者。
She’s the reigning queen of crime writers. 她是犯罪小说作家中的现任女王。
be supreme 至高无上的/最好的 In the contrary school, the duck is supreme . 在相反的流派中，鸭子是至高无上的。
First, you must give Helen back to my brother. Second, Troy must submit to my command to fight for me whenever I call. ...特洛伊必须服从我的命令，在我召唤时为我而战。
They are constantly after the turtles, who peacefully submit to all sorts of indignities .
The government finally decided to yield to public pressure on the new tax proposal. 政府最终决定屈服于公众对新税收提案的压力。
submit to … 屈服于…；服从于…；提交 They refused to submit to the demands of the invaders. 他们拒绝屈服于入侵者的要求。
bow to … 屈服于…；向…低头 She would never bow to the will of her controlling parents. 她永远不会屈服于她那控制欲强的父母的意愿。
succumb to … 屈服于…；最终死于…；被（疾病等）压倒 After a long battle with the illness, he eventually succumbed to it. 在与疾病进行了长期斗争之后，他最终死于该病。
He belongs to the Impressionist school of painting. 他属于印象派画派。
The policy reflects the thinking of the monetarist school . 这项政策反映了货币主义学派的思想。
Let a hundred flowers blossom and a hundred schools of thought contend.
The concept of " hundred schools of thought " refers to the philosophical diversity in ancient China. “百家争鸣”的概念指的是中国古代哲学思想的多样性。
Her singing style comes nearer to jazz than traditional blues. 她的演唱风格更接近爵士乐而非传统蓝调。
The duck's flight pattern comes nearer to the engines with which man has 'conquered' the air. 鸭子的飞行模式更接近于人类'征服'天空所用的发动机。
The final product should come nearer to the original design concept. 最终产品应该更接近最初的设计理念。
Man has his problems. 人类（个体）有他自己的问题。
Mankind / The human race has its problems. 人类（整体）有其自身的问题。
Although mankind has undergone no general improvement in intelligence or morality, it has made extraordinary progress in the accumulation of knowledge .
The team boasts of its undefeated season. 该队夸耀其不败赛季。
He always boasts that he was the top student in his class. 他总是吹嘘自己是班上最好的学生。
Often a valley boasted no inn at all. 通常一个山谷根本就没有旅馆。（物作主语，表示“拥有好的东西”）
She constantly boasts about her successful career and wealth. 她不断吹嘘她成功的事业和财富。
boast that ... 吹嘘/夸耀…（人做主语） The speaker boasted that he had raised millions of dollars for charity. 演讲者夸耀说他为慈善机构筹集了数百万美元。
boast (vt.) 拥有（值得骄傲的事物）；以…为傲（物做主语） The town boasts a highly rated public library and a renowned art museum. 这个小镇拥有一个评价很高的大型公共图书馆和一个著名的艺术博物馆。
Pumas are large, cat-like animals which are found in America . 美洲狮是生活在美洲的，像猫一样的大型动物。
He displays a child-like simplicity in his views on life. 他对生活的看法表现出孩子般的单纯。
The patient reported suffering from flu-like symptoms . 病人报告出现了流感样的症状。
When the woman shook her head in bewilderment, Harry went on to explain that 'myrolite' was a hard, amber-like substance which could be used to remove freckles .
As is shown in the picture, there is a cobweb-like structure with separate compartments packed in it.
cat-like 像猫一样的 She moved with a quiet, cat-like grace across the room. 她带着一种安静、像猫一样的优雅穿过房间。
bear-like animals 像熊一样的动物 The biologist was studying bear-like animals that lived in the Arctic region. 这位生物学家正在研究生活在北极地区的像熊一样的动物。
lady-like behavior 淑女般的行为 Her grandmother always insisted on proper, lady-like behavior at the dinner table. 她的祖母总是坚持在餐桌上要有得体的、淑女般的行为。
child-like simplicity 孩子般的简单/单纯 Despite his age, he maintained a refreshing child-like simplicity and honesty. 尽管他年纪大了，但他仍然保持着令人耳目一新的孩子般的简单和诚实。
an angel-like girl 像天使一样的女孩 The little girl, with her kind heart and gentle smile, looked like an angel-like girl . 那个善良、笑容温柔的小女孩看起来像一个天使一样的女孩。
crystal-like eyes 像水晶一样的眼睛 The baby looked up with clear, blue, crystal-like eyes . 婴儿用清澈、蓝色、像水晶一样的眼睛向上看。
flu-like symptoms 类似流感的症状 If you experience flu-like symptoms such as fever and body aches, please consult a doctor. 如果你出现了类似流感的症状，例如发烧和身体疼痛，请咨询医生。
He earns good money . 他赚了很多钱。
We’ve walked a good distance today. 我们今天走了很长一段距离。
Modern alpinists try to climb mountains by a route which will give them good sport , and the more difficult it is, the more highly it is regarded .
The rowers plied the oars tirelessly across the lake. 划船者不知疲倦地在湖上来回摆动船桨。
The waiter plied him with drinks all evening. 服务员整晚不停地给他提供饮料。（引申义：源源不断地提供）
The waiters kept plying the guests with champagne all evening. 服务员整个晚上都在不断地向客人们提供香槟。
ply sb. with questions 不断地向某人提问（或询问） As soon as she returned, the journalists started to ply her with questions about the incident. 她一回来，记者们就开始不断地向她提问有关该事件的问题。
I didn’t sleep a wink last night. 我昨晚一眼都没合。
She cried her eyes out when she heard the news. 听到消息后她哭得眼睛都肿了。
The car cost him an arm and a leg . 这辆车花了他一大笔钱。
It was rather like an exhibition of prehistoric electronic equipment .
Everybody was clapping their hands off .
I didn’t sleep a wink last night.
He has a skeleton of a wife .
It was rather like an exhibition of prehistoric electronic equipment.
a chance in a million
His anger nearly burst his belly .
She cried her eyes out .
The car cost him an arm and a leg .
Sailors struggled against the adverse wind for days. 水手们与逆风搏斗了数日。
The team faced unfavorable winds in the final leg of the race. 该队在比赛的最后阶段面临着逆风。
opposing gale / wind 逆风；反向风 The cyclist struggled to make progress against the strong opposing wind . 骑自行车的人在强劲的逆风中艰难前行。
adverse gale / wind 不利的风；逆风 The sailing ship made slow headway because of the adverse wind . 由于逆风，这艘帆船进展缓慢。
unfavorable gale / wind 不利的风；逆风 The pilot had to adjust the route due to unfavorable wind conditions. 由于不利的风况，飞行员不得不调整航线。
favorable gale / wind 有利的风；顺风 With a strong favorable wind , the boat finished the race quickly. 借助强劲的顺风，这艘船很快完成了比赛。
I shaved before I went to the party.
Alfred stayed in the camp a week before he returned to Athelney.
Looking at his watch, he saw that it was one o’clock, but the bell struck thirteen times before it stopped .
It will be a long time before we meet again. 我们要过很久 才 能再次相见。
I hadn’t waited long before he came.
…, but I decided to disembark before （连词、然后） I bought anything. ⇒ …, but I decided to disembark before （介词、然后） buying anything.

sentences.title: 野鸭子
lines: 7 Their humbler followers , such as partridges , have a like power of strong propulsion , but soon tire . like adj.类似的（只能作前置定语） Some (A) antibiotics used in (B) the treatment of human disease are like (C) only in that they are obtained (D) from fungi and bacteria. 老托福语法改错题(alike\similar) You may pick them up in utter exhaustion , if wind over the sea has driven them to a long journey . utter adj. 完全的；十足的；彻底的；v. 出声；说；讲 The swallow shares the virtues of both schools in highest measure . share v.有共同的/分享 virtue n.优点/长处 in highest measure 在最大程度上 It tires not , nor does it boast of its power ; but belongs to the air, travelling it may be 6,000 miles to and from its northern nesting home , feeding its flown young as it flies , and slipping through a medium that seems to help its passage even when the wind is adverse. It tires not. 它不知疲倦（古英语否定形式） nor does it... 也不…（nor引导的并列否定句，部分倒装） boast of / about ... 吹嘘、夸口、炫耀 it may be （插入语，“可能说是”）书上133页注释5，第三行表述有误 nesting home 筑巢的老家（home for nesting ） young (n.) 幼崽/幼兽/幼鸟 slip (v.) 滑行/溜走/悄悄移动 medium (n.) 媒介/介质（复数：media） passage n. 穿过；穿越 Such birds do us good , though we no longer take omens from their flight on this side and that; and even the most superstitious villagers no longer take off their hats to the magpie and wish it good-morning. do sb. good / do sb. harm 对…有益/有害 take omens from 用…占卜吉凶 superstitious / superstition 迷信的/迷信 wish sb. sth. 祝愿某人 每日习语 out of the blue 出乎意料, 突然地
Their humbler followers, such as partridges, have a like power of strong propulsion. 它们地位较低的追随者，例如鹧鸪，有着相似的强劲推进力。
We offer like products at competitive prices. 我们以有竞争力的价格提供类似的产品。
We are looking for someone with like interests to join our club. 我们正在寻找有相似兴趣的人加入我们的俱乐部。
alike 相似的（只能作表语） The twins look exactly alike . 这对双胞胎看起来一模一样。
similar 相似的（无限制） Anyone who has spent time with children is aware of the difference in the way boys and girls respond to similar situations . 任何花时间陪伴过孩子的人都知道男孩和女孩对类似情况的反应方式有所不同。
likely adj. 可能的 He is hardly likely to admit he was wrong. 他不大可能承认自己错了。
probable adj. 可能的 The probable cause of his death is traceable to an incident in 1724. 他可能的死因是源于1724年的一次事故。
If we glimpse the unutterable, it is unwise to try to utter it, nor should we seek to invest with significance that which we cannot grasp .
That’s utter nonsense . 那是彻头彻尾的胡言乱语。
He looked at me in utter disbelief . 他以完全不相信的眼神看着我。
She gazed at me in utter confusion . 她完全困惑地盯着我看。
utter (v.) 发出（声音）/说 If we glimpse the unutterable, it is unwise to try to utter it. 如果我们瞥见了不可言喻的东西，试图说出来是不明智的。
We share an interest in botany. 我们对植物学有着共同的兴趣。
I believe my view is widely shared .
Not everyone will share your enthusiasm for the plan. 不是每个人都会对你的计划抱有和你一样的热情。
That all great art has this power of suggesting a world beyond is undeniable. In some moods, Nature shares it .
The new design’s main virtue is its simplicity. 新设计的主要优点是简洁性。
The swallow shares the virtues of both schools. 燕子拥有这两个流派的共同优点。
Running, jumping and kicking a ball are tests of national virtue .
She contributed in highest measure to the success of the project. 她为项目的成功做出了最大程度的贡献。
The new law will solve the traffic problems in great measure . 新法律将在很大程度上解决交通问题。
The true value of a human being is determined primarily by the measure and the sense in which he has attained liberation from the self. 一个人的真正价值主要取决于他在多大 程度 上以及以何种方式实现了自我解放。
to the highest degree 在最大程度上 The machine is effective to the highest degree . 这台机器在最大程度上是有效的。
in great / large measure 在很大程度上 His success was in large measure due to his hard work. 他的成功在很大程度上归功于他的努力工作。
She loves me not . 她不爱我。（相当于 She doesn’t love me.）
And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country. 因此，我的美国同胞们，不要问你的国家能为你做什么；要问你能为你的国家做什么。
The swallow tires not , nor does it boast of its power. 燕子不知疲倦，也不夸耀它的力量。
Spiders are not insects, as many people think, nor even nearly related to them .
He didn't call, nor did he send a message. 他没有打电话，也没有发信息。
The company didn't apologize, nor did it offer a refund. 公司没有道歉，也没有提供退款。
We boast of what we have and do. 我们夸耀我们所拥有的和所做的。
Nobody should boast of his learning. 谁也不应当夸耀自己的学识。
She likes to boast about the cleverness of her child. 她喜欢夸耀她的孩子聪明。
Prodigal only one meter six, she was touted as nothing to boast about . 浪子才一米六，她却吹嘘成其貌不扬。
When you download the font it may be in a compressed format, such as a zip file. 下载这种字体时它可能是压缩格式的，例如压缩文件。
The bag has narrow straps, so it may be worn over the shoulder or carried in the hand. 这个书包有细长带子，所有它可以被肩挎，也可以用手拎。
A complete food it may be , but not quite as complete as a juicy steak. 它可能是一种完整的食物，但不像多汁的牛排那么完整。
God send it may be so! 天意如此！
Birds migrate back to their nesting homes every spring. 鸟类每年春天都会迁徙回它们的筑巢老家。
The scientists tracked the sea turtles back to their nesting home on the remote beach. 科学家们追踪海龟回到了它们在偏远海滩上的筑巢老家。
The swallow travels to and from its northern nesting home . 燕子来回于它北方的筑巢老家。
The mother fox and her young were hiding in the den. 狐狸妈妈和她的幼崽躲在巢穴里。
The swallow is feeding its flown young as it flies. 燕子一边飞翔一边喂养它已长大的幼鸟。
The lioness protected her young fiercely. 母狮凶猛地保护着她的幼崽。
He slipped on a piece of ice and broke his left leg .
The letter was slipped under your door . 信被悄悄塞进了你的门下。
He slipped quietly out of the room . 他悄悄地溜出了房间。
She slipped her arm through mine.
slip on the shoes ⇒ slip per
He slipped quietly out of the room.
His popularity slipped further after a series of scandals.
slip through the net 漏网之鱼/逃脱 The suspect managed to slip through the net and escape. 嫌疑人设法逃脱了。
Air is the medium through which sound travels. 空气是声音传播的介质。
The swallow is slipping through a medium that seems to help its passage. 燕子正在穿过似乎有助于它通过的介质。
Television is a popular medium of communication. 电视是一种流行的传播媒介。（复数：media）
medi um medi a
dat um dat a
strat um strat a
bacteri um bacteri a
curricul um curricul a
the passage of time 时间流逝
Pass 动词 (v.) 侧重于动作过程或“及格、传递” Pass the exam, Pass the ball
Past 介词/副词 (prep./adv.) 侧重于方位关系，“路过、越过” Walk past the bank
Through 介词 (prep.) 侧重于空间内部，“穿过、贯穿” Go through the tunnel
Passage 名词 (n.) 指代通道或流逝的过程 A secret passage, The passage of time
I think a trip to the beach would do us all a lot of good . 我认为去海滩旅行会对我们所有人都有好处。
A change of scenery might do you good . 换个环境可能会对你有好处。
Might do them good to step up and take care of themselves for a change. 改变一下，让他们自己前进，自己照顾自己，没准儿还对他们有好处。
do sb. harm 对..有害 The occasional piece of candy doesn’t do you any harm . 偶尔吃一块糖果不会对你造成任何伤害。
do more harm than good 弊大于利 Raising speed limits may do more harm than good . We regard them as unnecessary creatures that do more harm than good . 我们认为它们是不必要的生物，弊大于利。
benefit sb. 对…有益 Regular exercise will benefit your health . 经常锻炼将有益于你的健康。
Ancient priests used to take omens from the flight of birds. 古代祭司过去常常利用鸟类的飞行来占卜吉凶。
We no longer take omens from their flight on this side and that. 我们不再从它们飞向这一边或那一边来占卜吉凶。

take sth. as omens for 把……当作……的征兆 She took all the little things that happened that day as omens for their future married life. 她把那天发生的所有小事都当作他们未来婚姻生活的征兆。 In ancient times, people would take natural phenomena as omens for future events. 在古代，人们会将自然现象当作未来事件的征兆。
The villagers were very superstitious about black cats. 村民们对黑猫非常迷信。
We should try to break down superstition . 我们应该努力打破迷信。
Education can help people to overcome superstition . 教育可以帮助人们克服迷信。
foster superstition 助长迷信；培养迷信 Lack of scientific knowledge can sometimes foster superstition among the local people. 科学知识的缺乏有时会助长当地人的迷信思想。
break down / abolish superstition 破除迷信 The government launched a campaign to break down superstition in rural areas. 政府在农村地区发起了一场破除迷信的运动。
I wish you great success.
I wish you a splendid future.
We all wish you success in your new career. 我们都祝愿你在新的事业中取得成功。
may sb. do 祝愿某人…；愿某人… May God bless you. May you have a splendid future. May you have a long and happy life together. 愿你们白头偕老，生活幸福。
